          GUIDE
          
    
            
    How to Use AmmoMaster — 6-Step Balancing Walkthrough
    
            
    Ground rounds in real-world ballistics, tune armor cutoffs & flesh lethality independently, and export HEMTT-ready .hpp patches.
    
          
    
        
    
        
      
    

      
    
        
        
        
        
        
        
      
    

      
    

        
        
    
          
    
            
    
              
    Step 1: Select Ammunition & Align Real-World Ballistics (Card 1)
    
              
    Start in the left-hand Ammunition card. Filter by modpack or search across 832 scraped rounds, then inspect how the mod's config compares against real SAAMI / CIP / MIL-DTL / GRAU cartridge specifications.
    
            
    
            
          
    
          
    
            
    
              
    Search, Mod Filter & Barrel Length Card 1 Top
    
              
      
                
    • Use the mod dropdown (Vanilla, ACE3, Project M, Aegis, or ★ Session Tuned) and search box to pick any round.
      • 
                
    • If the round defines ACE_barrelLengths[], a barrel selector appears automatically so you can test carbine vs. SBR vs. DMR velocities.
      • 
                
    • Toggle ACE3 G1–G8 Drag in the top header to switch between vanilla airFriction and GNU Exterior Ballistics drag curves.
      • 
              
    
            
    
            
    
              
    1-Click Real-World Spec Alignment (181 Loads) Physics Diff
    
              
      
                
    • The Real-World Match box automatically pairs your round with its closest real-world load and flags discrepancies in initSpeed, typicalSpeed, ACE_muzzleVelocities[], bullet mass, or G1/G7 BC.
      • 
                
    • Click Apply RW Spec to synchronize velocity, barrel tables, bullet mass, drag model, and airFriction in one click—or browse all 181 presets under the Real-World Spec sub-tab.
      • 
              
    
            
    
          
    
          
    
            Pro Tip: Grounding flight ballistics first (velocity, mass, BC, typicalSpeed) means downrange energy decay is physically realistic before you touch armor penetration or damage.
          
    
        
    

        
        
    
          
    
            
    
              
    Step 2: Pick Target Armor, Hitzone & Custom Plate Tiers (Card 3)
    
              
    Use the right-hand Target Armor card to choose what your round is shooting at—any of 287 vests, 262 helmets, and 168 base uniforms across 11 anatomical hitpoints.
    
            
    
            
          
    
          
    
            
    
              
    Body Zone & Gear Presets Card 3 Top
    
              
      
                
    • Click Torso (Vest) or Head (Helm), or pick a specific hitzone (Chest, Diaphragm, Abdomen, Pelvis, Arms, Legs).
      • 
                
    • Coverage pills under the vest selector show which torso sub-zones are armored vs. exposed soft tissue.
      • 
                
    • Warning banners automatically alert you when a vest triggers ACE3's #9063 logarithmic over-cap (armor > 24 on vests or > 12 on helmets).
      • 
              
    
            
    
            
    
              
    Custom Vest / Helmet Tuning Lvl I–V
    
              
      
                
    • Click Lvl I through Lvl V (6, 15, 21, 40, 55 mm RHAe) or edit armor & passThrough directly to rebalance a vest or helmet.
      • 
                
    • Click Stop Round @ Dist to immediately set the vest/helmet to the minimum ACE tier needed to stop the active round at your current Test Engagement Distance.
      • 
              
    
            
    
          
    
          
    
            Pro Tip: Keep Apply edits across all Torso hitpoints checked when tuning a plate carrier so HitChest, HitDiaphragm, and HitAbdomen stay consistent.
          
    
        
    

        
        
    
          
    
            
    
              
    Step 3: Set Armor Penetration Cutoffs Visually (Card 2 · Control A)
    
              
    Instead of guessing abstract CfgAmmo >> caliber numbers, drag the horizontal range bars directly in meters and let AmmoMaster inverse-solve caliber for you.
    
            
    
            
          
    
          
    
            
    
              
    Draggable Penetration Matrix (0–1000m) Control A
    
              
      
                
    • Grab any bar—Equipped Gear, ACE Levels I–V, or + Custom mm—and drag left/right (or type an exact meter cutoff in the right-hand input box).
      • 
                
    • The gray tick mark (│) shows the round's original scraped cutoff; the glowing yellow line shows your current Test Engagement Distance.
      • 
                
    • Use quick buttons Stop @ 0m (defeated point-blank) or Match Test Dist for instant alignment.
      • 
              
    
            
    
            
    
              
    4 Tactical Cutoff Criteria Goal Selector
    
              
      
                
    • Penetrate & Bleed (> 0.35): Exact ACE3 boundary where blunt Contusion turns into bleeding VelocityWound / Avulsion.
      • 
                
    • 1-Shot Knockdown: Distance out to which 1 torso/head hit exceeds ACE3's trauma unconsciousness threshold.
      • 
                
    • Heart-Shot (≥ 0.60): Distance where torso wounds can trigger ACE3's 5% instant fatal heart-hit check.
      • 
                
    • 100% Raw RHAe: Pure kinetic steel perforation (v × cal × 0.015 ≥ plate mm).
      • 
              
    
            
    
          
    
        
    

        
        
    
          
    
            
    
              
    Step 4: Tune Unarmored Flesh Lethality Independently (Card 2 · Control B)
    
              
    In ACE3, changing hit normally shifts armor penetration ranges too—making balancing frustrating. AmmoMaster solves this with automatic decoupled locking.
    
            
    
            
          
    
          
    
            
    
              
    Lock Armor Pen Range (Decoupled Solver) Key Feature
    
              
      
                
    • When Lock Armor Pen Range is checked (default), dragging the Flesh Lethality (hit) slider automatically compensates caliber in real time so your armor penetration cutoff meter mark stays pinned!
      • 
                
    • Uncheck it anytime if you want raw hit edits to leave caliber untouched and shift both flesh and plate performance together.
      • 
              
    
            
    
            
    
              
    BI Kinetic Energy Profiles (√KE / 5) Control B
    
              
      
                
    • Click AP 0.88×, FMJ 1.0×, EPR 1.12×, or JHP 1.25× to derive hit from muzzle kinetic energy using Bohemia Interactive's empirical formula, scaled by projectile terminal behavior.
      • 
                
    • Watch the Unarmored KO / Kill badge and top Verdict Banner update live as you tune.
      • 
              
    
            
    
          
    
        
    

        
        
    
          
    
            
    
              
    Step 5: Verify on the ACE3 Medical Dummy, Firing Range & Charts
    
              
    Scroll to the bottom workspace to test real ACE3 wound trauma, stochastic multi-shot bursts, side-by-side caliber/vest lineups, and 0–1500m ballistics curves.
    
            
    
            
          
    
          
    
            
    
              
    1-Shot Preview vs. Live Firing Range ACE3 GUI

      • 
                
    • Fire 1 Shot / 3-Rnd Burst: Switches to stochastic simulation using ACE3's exact random [0.9, 1.0, 1.1] triangular roll, fractures, limping, Tourniquet, and Bandage actions.

    Lineups, 4 Interactive Charts & 11 Hitzones Bottom Tabs

      • 
                
    • Hover any of the 4 downrange charts to compare Dashed (Original Preset) vs. Solid (Tuned) curves across 0–1500m, or inspect Step-by-Step Math and All 11 Hitzones.

    Step 6: Multi-Item Session Persistence & Batch .hpp Export
    
              
    Tune an entire caliber family and vest lineup in one sitting, then export a single clean, topologically sorted Arma 3 config patch.

    • Modified items display a ✎ prefix in dropdowns, appear in the ★ Session Tuned mod filter, and are pinned at the top of the Caliber Lineup table.

          Σ MATHS
          
    
            
    Validated Arma 3 & ACE 3.21.2 Ballistics, Armor & Medical Mathematics
    
            
    Exact closed-form & numerical equations implemented in wizard_engine.js, verified against RV4 Engine formulas and ACE 3.21.2 source SQF.
    
          
    
        
    
        
      
    

      
    
        
        
        
        
        
        
      
    

      
    

        
        
    
          
    
            LIVE ACTIVE SHOT TELEMETRY: —
            Mode: ACE3 Armor Pen
          
    
          
    
            
    Impact v(x)-
    
            
    Bullet RHAe-
    
            
    ACE Plate / r_pen-
    
            
    ACE D_final / d_w-
    
            
    Bleed Rate-
    
            
    P(KO) / P(Fatal)-
    
          
    
        
    

        
        
    
          
    
            
    1A. Vanilla Arma 3 Exponential Drag ODE RV4 ShotBullet · airFriction
    
            
    In base Arma 3 (when ACE3 Advanced Ballistics is disabled or a projectile lacks ACE_ballisticCoefficients[]), deceleration is strictly proportional to velocity squared with constant k = airFriction < 0 (units of m−1):
    
            
    dv/dt = k · v²   ⇒   dv/dx = (dv/dt) / v = k · v

v(x)   = v₀ · exp(k · x)
ToF(x) = (exp(−k · x) − 1) / (−k · v₀)
KE(x)  = ½ · (m_grams / 1000) · v(x)²        // Joules (J)
    
          
    

          
    
            
    1B. ACE 3.21.2 GNU Exterior Ballistics G1–G8 Drag ace_advanced_ballistics_fnc_calculateRetardation
    
            
    When ACE3 G1–G8 Drag is active, AmmoMaster evaluates the exact piecewise Mach/velocity power-law tables (v_min_fps, A_i, M_i) from GNU Exterior Ballistics for models G1, G2, G5, G6, G7, G8 under ICAO standard sea-level atmosphere (15°C, 1013.25 hPa) and integrates spatially via 2nd-order Runge-Kutta (RK2 midpoint):
    
            
    v_fps = v_mps × 3.2808399
a_drag(v) = [ A_i · (v_fps ^ M_i) / BC ] / 3.2808399    // Retardation in m/s² for table bracket v_fps > v_min_i

// Spatial ODE dv/dx = −a_drag(v) / v integrated over adaptive step Δx ∈ [0.25m, 1.5m]:
v_mid  = v − 0.5 · Δx · (a_drag(v) / v)
v_next = v − Δx · (a_drag(v_mid) / v_mid)
Δt     = Δx / [ 0.5 · (v + v_next) ]
    
            
      
              
    • BC → Vanilla airFriction Fitting: Whenever you edit BC or apply a Real-World Spec, solveAirFrictionFromBC integrates G1/G7 flight to x = 250 m and sets airFriction = ln(v_250 / v₀) / 250 so AI and non-AB sessions match downrange trajectory.
      • 
              
    • ACE_muzzleVelocities[] Scaling: When initSpeed changes, syncAceBarrelMuzzleVelocities scales the barrel velocity array by v₀_new / v_ref_orig (anchoring to the ~16" / 406.4 mm barrel entry if the mod's original initSpeed and barrel array differed by >8%).
      • 
            
    
          
    
        
    

        
        
    
          
    
            
    2A. Kinetic RHAe Penetration & Ricochet RV4 Engine · ARMOR_PENETRABILITY = 0.015
    
            
    Both Real Virtuality 4 fire-geometry penetration and ACE3's armor penetration handler compute rolled homogeneous armor equivalency (mm RHAe) linearly from normal impact speed and dimensionless CfgAmmo >> caliber:
    
            
    v_eff       = v(x) · max(0.05, cos θ)                // θ = impact obliquity angle (deg)
RHAe_mm     = v_eff × caliber × 0.015                // 15 mm RHAe per 1000 m/s at caliber = 1.0
Concrete_mm = RHAe_mm × (80 / 15)                    // 80 mm per 1000 m/s at caliber = 1.0
Meat_mm     = RHAe_mm × (250 / 15)                   // 250 mm tissue channel reference
isRicochet  = (θ > 90° − deflecting)
    
          
    

          
    
            
    2B. Base Arma 3 Hitpoint & Structural Damage CAManBase HitPoints
    
            
    Note that Arma 3 scales kinetic bullet damage linearly with v_eff / typicalSpeed (kinetic energy scales with v², while raw engine hit scales with v):
    
            
    D_raw    = hit · (1 − explosive) · (v_eff / typicalSpeed) + hit · explosive
A_uni    = unitBaseArmor × hitpointArmorMult          // Typically 2.0 × 1.0 = 2.0 on CAManBase
A_van    = max(1.0, A_uni + A_vest_raw + A_helm_raw)
PT_eff   = PT_hitpoint × PT_vest × PT_helm

D_hp     = D_raw / A_van                              // Passed into HandleDamage event handler!
D_struct = (D_hp × PT_eff) / armorStructural          // Global total-damage transfer (default structural = 4.0)
    
            
      
              
    • In vanilla Arma 3 (without ACE Medical), vital hitpoints (Head, Face, Neck, Chest, Diaphragm, Abdomen, Pelvis) kill immediately at max(D_hp, D_struct) ≥ 1.0, whereas limb hits only kill via cumulative D_struct ≥ 1.0.
      • 
            
    
          
    
        
    

        
        
    
          
    
            
    3A. Over-Capped Armor Logarithmic Scaling (#9063) ace_medical_engine_fnc_getItemArmor
    
            
    To prevent extreme modded vest/helmet configs from making units invincible, ACE 3.21.2 compresses item armor logarithmically whenever raw armor exceeds 6 tier steps (armor > 24 for vests where step = 4, or armor > 12 for helmets where step = 2):
    
            
    Δ_step = 4 (vest)  |  2 (helmet)
α_pt   = 0.6 (vest) | 1.0 (helmet)
PT_c   = clamp(passThrough, 0.1, 1.0)

A_item_ace = (A_raw > 6 · Δ_step)
           ? 10 · log10( A_raw / (PT_c ^ α_pt) )
           : A_raw

A_total_ace = max(1.0, A_uni + A_vest_ace + A_helm_ace)
D_real      = D_hp × A_total_ace                      // Reconstructs unarmored raw damage inside ACE
    
          
    

          
    
            
    3B. Discrete ACE Armor Levels I–V & Post-Plate Damage ace_medical_damage_fnc_woundsHandlerArmorPenetration
    
            
    For ACE_damageType = "bullet", when net armor above base skin (A_net = A_total_ace − 2.0) exceeds one step (> 4 on torso, > 2 on head), ACE quantizes protection into 5 discrete RHAe plate thicknesses:
    
            
    
              
                
    ACE TierLevel ILevel IILevel IIILevel IVLevel V
    
                  
              
                
    Plate RHAe (T_plate)6 mm15 mm21 mm40 mm55 mm
    
                
    Torso A_net Bracket (Δ=4)4.1 – 1010 – 1414 – 1818 – 22> 22
    
                
    Head A_net Bracket (Δ=2)2.1 – 55 – 77 – 99 – 11> 11
    
                  
            
    
            
    idx     = clamp( round( (A_net − 2·Δ_step) / Δ_step ), 0, 4 )
T_plate = [6, 15, 21, 40, 55][idx]                    // mm RHAe

v_ace   = (D_real / hit) × max(typicalSpeed, 1)
d_pen   = v_ace × caliber × 0.015                     // Bullet RHAe mm at impact
r_pen   = min(1.0, d_pen / T_plate)                   // Fraction of plate perforated ∈ [0, 1]
D_final = (hit × r_pen) / 10.0                        // DAMAGE_SCALING_FACTOR = 10.0
    
            
    When unarmored (A_net ≤ Δ_step), the armor penetration handler is bypassed and D_final = D_hp = D_raw / A_van directly (so for base uniform A_van = 2.0, an unarmored muzzle hit yields D_final ≈ hit / 2, which is 5× higher than the armored hit / 10 ceiling!).
    
          
    
        
    

        
        
    
          
    
            
    4A. Fractional Wound Count & The 0.35 Penetration Threshold ACE_Medical_Injuries.hpp
    
            
    ACE interpolates expected wound count E[N] from D_final across bullet thresholds [[20, 10], [4.5, 2], [3, 1], [0, 1]] (so for 0 < D_final ≤ 3.0, exactly N = 1 wound is created and d_wound = D_final):
    
            
    d_wound = D_final / N                                 // Per-wound damage driving wound type weights:

• d_wound ≤ 0.35 : 100% Contusion      (bleed=0.00, pain=0.3×2.2, sizeMult=3.2) → STOPPED (Blunt Bruise)
• 0.35 < d_wound < 1.0 : VelocityWound (bleed=0.20, pain=0.9, sizeMult=0.9) + Avulsion (bleed=0.10, pain=1.0)
• d_wound ≥ 1.50 : 100% Avulsion       (severe tissue cavitary wound)
    
            
    Notice the mathematical consequence when N = 1: penetrating an ACE plate requires d_wound > 0.35 ⇔ (hit × r_pen) / 10 > 0.35 ⇔ r_pen > 3.5 / hit! For a rifle round with hit = 9.5, bleeding begins at r_pen = 36.8% of plate thickness; if hit ≤ 3.5, a bullet can never exceed 0.35 through armor even at r_pen = 100%.
    
          
    

          
    
            
    4B. Wound Sizing & Exact SQF Triangular Variance random [0.9, 1.0, 1.1]
    
            
    In live SQF execution, ACE multiplies incoming damage by random [0.9, 1, 1.1]—the sum of two uniform variables, forming a symmetric triangular distribution on [0.9, 1.1]. Rather than noisy Monte Carlo approximations, AmmoMaster computes exact analytical survival probabilities using the closed-form complementary CDF:
    
            
    woundSize = clamp_lerp(0.1 → 2.0,  d_wound × sizeMult,  0.125 → 1.0)
bleed_w   = woundSize × bleedMult × baseBleeding      // Fraction of cardiac output
pain_w    = woundSize × painMult  × basePain

P(V ≥ r) = | 1.0                          if r ≤ 0.9
           | 1.0 − 0.5 · ((r − 0.9)/0.1)² if 0.9 < r ≤ 1.0
           | 0.5 · ((1.1 − r)/0.1)²       if 1.0 < r < 1.1
           | 0.0                          if r ≥ 1.1
    
          
    
        
    

        
        
    
          
    
            
    5A. Vital Organ Death, Weibull Trauma & Unconsciousness ace_medical_damage & status
    
            
    Let M_th be the mission's ACE_medical_playerDamageThreshold (header Trauma Mult, default 1.0):
    
            
    // 1. Immediate Vital Organ / Cranial Fatality (per-wound check):
Head Fatal  : V · d_wound ≥ 1.00                      // Instant lethal cranial destruction
Heart Fatal : V · d_wound ≥ 0.60  with 5% roll        // HEART_HIT_CHANCE = 0.05 on Torso

// 2. Cumulative Part Trauma Weibull Fatality (XEH_preInit.sqf: 10% @ +0.5, 90% @ +0.8):
k = ln(ln(0.9)/ln(0.1)) / ln(0.5/0.8) ≈ 6.5593,   λ = 0.5 / (−ln 0.9)^(1/k) ≈ 0.7041
T_part = 1.25 · M_th (Head)  |  1.50 · M_th (Torso)
P_weibull(D_part) = 1 − exp( −( max(0, D_part − T_part) / λ )^k )

// 3. Unconsciousness (fnc_handleIncapacitation):
Head Trauma KO  : D_head ≥ 0.50 · M_th
Torso Trauma KO : (d_wound ≥ 0.35) AND (D_body ≥ 1.00 · M_th)
Pain Shock KO   : (Pain ≥ 0.50) triggers a 10% roll per hit (PAIN_UNCONSCIOUS_CHANCE = 0.10)
    
          
    

          
    
            
    5B. Regional Hemorrhage Caps & Time to Cardiac Arrest ace_medical_status_fnc_getBloodLoss
    
            
    ACE caps raw bleeding per limb before multiplying by instantaneous Cardiac Output (CO₀ = 0.095 L × 80 BPM / 60 = 0.12667 L/s = 126.7 mL/s). Fatal exsanguination occurs when blood volume drops from 6.0 L to 3.0 L (mean decaying CO ≈ 82 mL/s):
    
            
    B_core  = min(1.0,  min(0.9, B_head) + min(1.0, B_body))
B_limbs = min(1.0,  min(0.3, B_LA) + min(0.3, B_RA) + min(0.5, B_LL) + min(0.5, B_RL)) × (1 − B_core)
B_total = B_core + B_limbs                            // Tourniquet sets limb B_i = 0

Initial Flow (mL/s) = B_total × 126.67 mL/s
Est. Time to Arrest = 3.0 L / (B_total × 0.082 L/s)   // Seconds from 6.0 L → 3.0 L
    
          
    
        
    

        
        
    
          
    
            
    6A. Bisection Cutoff & Inverse caliber Solvers computeMaxCriterionRange / solveCaliberForTargetRange
    
            
    Because G1–G8 velocity decay and multi-wound ACE thresholds are non-invertible algebraically, AmmoMaster uses fast monotonic bisection:
    
            
      
              
    • Max Cutoff Range (computeMaxCriterionRange): 22 bisection steps on [0, 2000] m (±0.0005 m precision) testing whether the chosen goal passes at distance x.
      • 
              
    • Inverse caliber Solver (solveCaliberForTargetRange): 28 bisection steps on caliber ∈ [0.02, 30.0] so the target plate transitions from passing to stopped right at desiredDist + 0.25 m (or targets ratio = 0.85 at 0 m for Stop @ 0m so even a +10% roll cannot penetrate).
      • 
              
    • Minimum Viable hit Guard: If a user requests a cutoff > 0m for ace_bleed (requires hit > 3.52), ace_heart (hit ≥ 6.0), or ace_ko (hit ≥ 10.0 · M_th), the solver automatically bumps hit to the mathematical minimum when dragging the penetration bar.
      • 
            
    
          
    

          
    
            
    6B. Decoupled Lock Armor Pen Range & BI Energy Profiles Ammunition Balancing Invariants
    
            
    // Invariant maintaining constant post-armor wound damage D_final at cutoff distance x_c:
D_final(x_c) = [ hit × v(x_c) × caliber × 0.015 ] / (10 × T_plate) = const
  ⇒  caliber_new = caliber_old × (hit_old / hit_new)   (refined via full 28-step bisection for N > 1 wounds)

// Bohemia Interactive empirical hit baseline from muzzle kinetic energy KE₀ (Joules):
hit_BI = k_profile × (√KE₀ / 5.0)
  where k_profile = 0.88 (Sub-caliber AP) | 1.00 (FMJ Ball) | 1.12 (Yawing EPR/OTM) | 1.25 (Expanding JHP)
